_doc: Pilot personality presets for Phase 5b offline playtest framework. 5 behavioral axes per OQ-3 + 6 named presets per Decision 3 of OFFLINE_PLAYTEST_DESIGN.md. Axes: aggression / politics / threat_assessment / alliance_formation / removal_targeting (each 0.0..1.0). Presets are starting-point references; per-deck personality assignment happens at sim setup (stage 5b.6). CALIBRATION-ONLY pack — never read by runtime layers; manifest entry has calibration_only:true.

archenemy_aware._doc: Always targets the leader; threat-assessment-driven aggression.

combo._doc: Race the combo; ignore the table until ready.

control._doc: React to threats; minimize own profile.

shark._doc: Always target the lead; punish weakness.
